cases.name: Preserve identifier text
cases.prompt: A CSV has account_id values like 00123 and 00456. read_csv() guesses them as integers. Review the import contract and prevent loss of leading zeros.
cases.description: Declare identifier columns explicitly so parsing does not destroy meaningful leading zeros.
traps: Convert after parsing without considering lost zeros

assertions.text: Explains why type guessing is not a contract

cases.name: Specify locale-sensitive parsing
cases.prompt: A European export uses semicolon separators, comma decimals, dot grouping marks, and dates like 31/12/2025. Write the import decisions and identify the parser settings that must be explicit.
cases.description: Make delimiter, numeric locale, date format, and column types explicit for a regional export.

assertions.text: Sets delimiter or uses the appropriate reader

cases.name: Quarantine parsing failures
cases.prompt: The file loads with a warning and 12 malformed numeric fields. The analyst wants to replace all failures with NA and continue. Give a safe review and quarantine strategy.
cases.description: Inspect malformed fields and define a contract for failing or quarantining bad input.
traps: Treat parse failures as ordinary missingness
Drop bad rows without source context

assertions.text: Distinguishes malformed input from source missingness
Defines whether the pipeline fails or quarantines based on a contract
